evals.prompt: Replacing a saved expense fails and the old record disappears. Describe the root-cause investigation and a data-retention regression test without editing files.
evals.expected_output: Trace validation and destructive writes, use a single transaction, reject invalid amounts/dates before modification, inject a failed insert in an isolated DB, verify the original record survives, and preserve user/external-ID scoping.

evals.prompt: I need a new persisted asset field that also survives CSV backup and Net Worth synchronization. Plan all affected surfaces and compatibility checks without editing files.
evals.expected_output: Cover TS/OpenAPI/DDL, forward/rollback migration, server mappers, canonical stores, conversion helpers and CSV import/export. Verify legacy payloads, round trips, demo guards, current-snapshot scope and explicit store ownership without rewriting shipped migrations.
